summary: Implemented T03 real calendar collections: PROPFIND on calendar-home (Depth 0/1) and calendar-collection endpoints, projecting active ACL-authorized calendars with stable paths, display properties, resource types, and role-derived DAV privileges; revoked/archived/foreign calendars are hidden.
follow_up: e2e suite could be extended to exercise the new calendar-home/collection PROPFIND endpoints over real HTTP (optional; T03 verification is the cargo caldav::http suite).
important_context: Collection key is the numeric calendars.id (stable AUTOINCREMENT) — this is the frozen collection ID for T04/T15.

Privilege mapping is derived from the existing authorize_calendar_action matrix (owner→DAV:all+write+acl; editor→write-content/calendar-write; viewer→read; free-busy→read+calendar-write-freebusy) — frozen privilege mapping for T04/T15.
Calendar-home is owner-only (cross-user principal → 404), consistent with T02; shared calendars are reached via the owner's principal URL and authorized by calendar_acl.
Free-busy viewers are granted DAV:read so they can read calendar metadata (name/color); event-level free-busy restriction is deferred to T04+.
